claims.quote:
In our approach two kinds of data are required to use the simulation model. 
On the one hand data should be obtained from whatever records are available, 
such as rainfall and evaporation. On the other hand data can be determined by 
first estimates in the field, e.g. for the runoff coefficient and threshold value. 
Also, missing data can be provided by on site experiments such as determina- 
tion of hydraulic conductivity, and by laboratory analysis of soil samples for 
instance for the soil texture or the soil water retention curve.
